notes:
Root cause: `memoize` in src/memoize.ts looked up the cache (`cache.has`/`cache.get`) but never wrote to it — the computed value was returned without `cache.set(arg, value)`. The Map stayed empty, so every call, including repeated calls with the same argument, re-invoked the underlying function and returned a fresh result, violating all three tests (call count of 1 for repeats, and identical-reference return).

Fix: added `cache.set(arg, value);` after `const value = fn(arg);` in src/memoize.ts, so the first call per distinct argument populates the cache and subsequent calls with the same argument return the cached value by reference without re-running the underlying function.

No test files were modified. Shell/test execution was blocked by the harness allowlist, so verification was by source inspection: test/memoize.test.ts is the only suite and imports only from src/memoize.ts; the fix satisfies all three cases (once-per-argument invocation, call-through for new arguments, and identical result object on repeat calls).
